legacy_perf_tests:
The two legacy `performance` tests ran once (`pytest -q -n 16 --dist=worksteal -m performance`, at HEAD f9660fc, 10:44 UTC).
Preflight: `nproc` 256, load average 50.95 / 41.10 / 38.85, vmstat idle 75-98%; 46.13 after the run.
Ten other workers kept the host busy, so these numbers are **measured under load**. They are
not suitable for setting thresholds, and none were changed. Five of the seven items exceed
their absolute limits but stay within the recorded relative baselines (+15%) in
`tests/perf/baselines/amd-epyc-7763-64-core-processor-256c.json`.

v2 columns use `Engine(max_workers=16, native_loop_iteration_budget=10_000_000)` with the
same timed region and v2 interp. *B* is a frozen copy of 519b569 plus worktree (09:37 UTC). *C*
is a frozen copy of 2dc66ae plus worktree (11:04 UTC), after W2 stopped forcing a single
partition for `wait_until` / declared-word kernels. Mega-MoE was not in the corpus sweep: it
crashed (V2C-33) and then hit OOB at the sweep snapshot.

| workload | legacy limit | legacy baseline | legacy now | pass (abs) | v2 B | v2 C | v2 verdict vs legacy |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| NumSim max config t8192_m8192_h7168_i3072_e384_k6_g1 | 140 s | 216.35 s | 185.49 s | fail | - | not run (medium already 2.5x legacy) | - |
| NumSim medium_moe t64_h2048_i1536_e96_k4_g1 (148 SMs; not a perf test) | - | - | 4.17 s | - | did not finish in 10 min (W5) | 10.37 s | outputs match, clean (same) |
| Racecheck two_tokens | 2.39 s | 1.94 s | 2.11 s | pass | 12.70 s | 12.12 s | **differs**: v2 error, 11 findings; legacy clean |
| Racecheck sixteen_tokens | 2.3 s | 2.00 s | 2.38 s | fail | 15.27 s | - | **differs**: v2 error, 10 findings |
| Racecheck shared_expert | 2.3 s | 2.04 s | 2.58 s | fail | 16.09 s | - | **differs**: v2 error, 46 findings |
| Racecheck twenty_four_experts | 2.7 s | 2.75 s | 2.89 s | fail | 116.12 s | 41.56 s | **differs**: v2 error, 337-338 findings |
| Racecheck medium_moe | 16.7 s | 22.34 s | 21.09 s | fail | did not finish in 25 min (W5) | did not finish in 900 s | - |
| Racecheck large_moe | 35.0 s | 38.01 s | 34.58 s | pass | not run | not run | - |

Mega-MoE is the largest gap between v2 and legacy. NumSim is now 2.5x legacy on medium_moe.
Racecheck is 6-14x slower on the small configs and does not finish on medium_moe; its verdicts also
still differ from legacy (racecheck conformance). This is an interp and checker problem.
Codegen cannot close it (see the recommendation).
